build_roberta_encoder: build a RoBERTa encoder model for bidirectional language understanding with positional and token-type embeddings
create_roberta_causal_lm: create a RoBERTa causal language model for autoregressive text generation with cross-attention support
test_roberta_masked_lm: test the RoBERTa masked language model for cloze-style token prediction with cross-entropy loss
run_roberta_sequence_classifier: run a RoBERTa sequence classifier for GLUE-style text classification with configurable loss functions
review_roberta_question_answering: review the RoBERTa question answering model for extractive span prediction with start and end logits
